assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture rhythm data during daily activities
The service is clinically appropriate for this member
The denial conflicts with the documented clinical indication that this service is necessary to correlate syncope and near-syncope with underlying arrhythmia
